scientific_goal: Attack the remaining universal W4 certified-step obligation simultaneously from the proof side and the counterexample side without allowing either lane to adapt after seeing the other lane's result.
U: FOR_EVERY_REACHABLE_CANONICAL_W4_STATE_F: R33_PROGRESS_OR_TERMINAL(F) OR EXISTS_v_R49H_SAFE(F,v) OR EXISTS_v_R47J_SAFE(F,v)

proof_lane.required_reduction: Assume a minimal reachable counterexample F*. Then R33 is a literal fixed point, no R49H pivot exists, and every pivot has a replay-valid R47J candidate whose final normalized nonterminal state still has width >4.
proof_lane.open_bridge: Show that in every reachable R33-fixed no-R49H W4 state at least one pivot has no certified wide survivor after R47J normalization.

falsifier_lane.target: An explicit satisfiable canonical W4 state K such that R33(K) is STALLED_STACK_LEAN_CORE, no pivot satisfies R49H, and exact replayed R47J is unsafe for every current pivot.
falsifier_lane.reason_for_start: With at most five variables, any non-tautological pivot resolvent contains literals from at most four remaining variables, hence chi_star<=4 for every bipolar pivot.
falsifier_lane.sat_generation: PLANTED_WITNESS_WITH_EXACT_DIRECT_REPLAY; SAT witness is discovery scaffolding only.
falsifier_lane.required_candidate_replay: Every pivot must be independently recomputed through the frozen R49H/R47J machinery before CURRENT_MACHINE_DEADCORE_FOUND is allowed.
falsifier_lane.if_found: Persist the complete formula, SAT witness, every variable profile, every R47J final state/reason, and then minimize clauses/literals/variables by delete-and-replay without changing the frozen machine.

promotion_rule.explicit_deadcore: REFUTES_U_FOR_THE_FROZEN_MACHINE_IF_THE_STATE_IS_REACHABLE_UNDER_THE_FROZEN_REACHABILITY_DEFINITION; otherwise it refutes only the stronger all-W4 formulation and becomes a reachability probe.
